item.description: A portion of $40 billion in debt financing to pay for artificial intelligence chips for SpaceX may start being sold as soon as this week, with Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. serving as underwriters on the expected deal, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.
